decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box builds directly on the firm's fluid-handling fabrication for utilities, so it costs little to carry, and its value is still uncertain after only one year, which makes the option worth holding.

Public waste bins are distant from the core business and a multi-model line costs more to maintain, but public-sector buyers are already customers and one year is too early for the uncertainty to have resolved against it.
The ground sleeve line uses existing steel processing and surface treatment, so carrying cost is low, and with a narrow portfolio the firm holds few other options to move resources to.
Cast iron sleeves overlap with the broader ground sleeve line and may later be folded into it, but they cost little to list and there is no evidence yet that their value will not be realized.
Steel sleeves fit the firm's core steel competence and cost little to keep, so the option should be held until market evidence arrives.
